name: In Favor of Elune
summary: Young night elf priests leave Shadowglen for guidance and training in Dolanaar. Priestess Shanda sends them along the forest path to Laurna Morninglight.

sections.title: Leaving the Glade
sections.body: Priestess Shanda trains initiates serving Elune within Aldrassil's secluded shelter. Their learning begins with simple prayers and defensive invocations under her watchful eye. Shadowglen's cloistered life cannot prepare a priestess or priest for the turmoil gripping the wider world. Once an initiate shows steady faith and discipline, Shanda sends them down the shadowed forest path toward Dolanaar to continue their education.

sections.title: A Step Into the Priesthood
sections.body: Reaching Dolanaar marks an essential milestone in a night elf's divine vocation. There, respected priestess Laurna Morninglight prepares disciples for the trials facing Teldrassil. The acolyte can receive advanced instruction in moonlit spellcraft and claim their first formal vestments, marking their official standing within the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: Who sends me on this journey?
aliases: who starts in favor of elune
where do i get this quest
faq.answer: Priestess Shanda, the night elf priest trainer in Aldrassil's boughs in Shadowglen, gives you this guidance once your initial training is complete.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to find Laurna Morninglight?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight is in the northern building of Dolanaar, the first major settlement south of the Shadowglen gates in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: who can do in favor of elune
faq.answer: No. This is specifically for young night elf priests taking their first steps into the Sisterhood and the service of Elune.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Laurna Morninglight?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight greets you and offers the trial Garments of the Moon. It tests your ability to protect and heal wounded defenders before bestowing your first official clerical robes.

faq.q: Is this quest mandatory to continue priest training?
aliases: do i have to do in favor of elune
can i skip in favor of elune
faq.answer: This is an optional breadcrumb. If you travel directly to Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight still offers her training and subsequent tasks without this introduction.

faq.q: Why is earning garments so important to the Sisterhood?
faq.answer: Vestments are sacred symbols in night elf culture, not merely cloth. They mark one's official station, devotion, and readiness to channel the Moon Goddess's blessings in service of their people.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave simple novitiate studies for full service and begin the path toward earning your first consecrated clerical vestments.
As a night elf, you follow a traditional milestone for devotees: the Sisterhood of Elune forms the spiritual heart and historic leadership of kaldorei society.
